        where
            V: Visitor<'de>,

            match *self.content {
                Content::String(ref v) => visitor.visit_str(v),
                Content::Str(v) => visitor.visit_borrowed_str(v),
                Content::ByteBuf(ref v) => visitor.visit_bytes(v),

            }
        }
